name: SCIAK!
summary:
That buzz behind you is no joke. In SCIAK! mosquitoes invade your real room: they fly between your furniture, land on walls and tables, hide in corners and circle your head, waiting for the perfect moment to bite.

HOW TO PLAY
• Slap a surface to squash the ones that have landed, clap your hands to catch them in mid-air
• Bare hands need no controller: hand tracking is all it takes
• Spatial audio: the buzz tells you where they are, even when you can't see them
• Chain kills for combos up to x4

THREE MODES
